sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.authority_reason: Authors original research paper served by arXiv; original formula defining scaled dot-product attention.
sources.inspection_note: Independently read original PDF pp.3–4 §3.2/§3.2.1 and Eq.(1), from immutable phase4 PDF with independently verified bdfaa68d... hash; own extracted text lines145–190. It defines weighted value sum with content-compatible weights, softmax-normalized, and an output vector sharing value features. Supports the value read mechanism; not a claim that manual weights implement full attention.

sources.title: Attention is not Explanation
sources.version: Jain & Wallace, NAACL-HLT 2019, pp.3543–3556, ACL N19-1357
sources.authority_reason: Original peer-reviewed authors paper from publisher ACL Anthology.
sources.inspection_note: Fresh download; independently read PDF pp.1–2 (printed3543–3544), Abstract, §1 and §2. Counterfactual distributions and weak importance correlations warrant caution about assigning semantics or understanding from weights alone. Scope was classification/QA/NLI largely with RNN encoders, not a universal proof that no attention can be interpreted.

sources.title: Own weighted-mixture calculation and axes
sources.details: For w_i>=0 and sum_i w_i=1, output o_j=sum_i w_i*v_ij; denominator for a normalized weighted mean is sum(w)=1, with no /2. Positions are rows in V (2x2), features columns; weights length2 contracts the position axis into a length2 feature output. Exact decimals original[1.8,0.4], swap[0.2,3.6], scalar contributions0.9 and10; two two-feature cards would concatenate to four numbers but mix to two. Values/weights are dimensionless toy numbers with unnamed features. Algebra and CPU float32 error/tolerance controls are preserved in own notes and probe.

claims.statement: 非負且總和為1的比例逐特徵加權相加，得到來源卡片的混合；輸出特徵數相同，與原封拼接不同。
claims.scope: Normalized weighted value aggregation; arbitrary coordinates, not a claim that every weighted sum has normalized weights.

evidence.supports: Defines weighted sum of value vectors with softmax weights, yielding value-feature output; under nonnegative unit-sum weights it is a convex mixture.

evidence.locator: o_j=sum_i w_i*v_ij; sum(w)=1; inspection-notes.md Own calculation
evidence.supports: Coordinatewise sum leaves feature count2; concatenating two length2 arrays has4 numbers and differs from length2 mixture.

claims.scope: Two positions, two unitless features; weighted mean denominator is sum(weights)=1, not position count2.

evidence.locator: Exact Decimal calculations in probe.py; probe-result.json exact_original and axis_and_units
evidence.supports: 0.9*2+0.1*0=1.8 and 0.9*0+0.1*4=0.4, with position contraction and no extra division.

claims.scope: Covers torch import,tensor creation,@,print,assert/allclose and the full original fence; no learning, gradient update or performance evaluation.

evidence.supports: Tensor defaults requires_grad=False and creates data without history; 1-D×2-D matmul removes the temporary leading axis; allclose returns per-element combined Boolean under stated tolerances.
Only constants, forward multiplication, print and assert occur; no nn.Parameter, backward, optimizer or update.
All original tensors require no gradients and output has no grad_fn. A+0.01 second-feature error fails comparison; +1e-6 first-feature change passes default tolerance.

verification.observed: Original fence exits0; numerical and explicit sum agree; all three original tensors require no grad; no output grad_fn; allclose true for original, false after second feature+0.01, true after first feature+1e-6.
verification.details: Installed Python3.13.5 and torch2.14.1+cpu exact commit5c488690..., CPU1 thread; official originals match installed contract. allclose defaults abs(input_i-other_i)<=1e-8+1e-5*abs(other_i) for all i, not training.

claims.statement: 注意力的核心讀取是依比例混合多個位置的值，無需只選一個位置；本節的比例由人指定，尚未根據內容計算。
claims.scope: Value aggregation part of ordinary softmax attention; manual coefficients are a teaching example, not full learned attention.

evidence.locator: PDF pp.3–4 §3.2 weighted value sum;§3.2.1 Eq.(1)
evidence.supports: Original attention definition assigns compatible weights to each value and computes their weighted sum; matrix formula is softmax(scores)V, allowing more than one nonzero source weight.
Explicit constants verify this example manually chooses coefficients instead of producing them from query/key content.

claims.statement: 較大比例不保證帶回較大數值：同一格0.9×1=0.9，而0.1×100=10。
claims.scope: Single feature numeric contribution compares coefficient times source magnitude; does not claim attention coefficient has no effect.

evidence.supports: Exact products0.9 and10 show source values affect contribution magnitude independently of weight ordering.
CPU multiplies coefficients by[1,100] and asserts[0.9,10], with second contribution larger.

verification.observed: Float32[0.8999999761581421,10.0]; comparison confirms second contribution greater.

verification.tolerance: Independent exact error of0.9 contribution2.39e-8 <1e-6; contribution10 exactly represented; default allclose comparison to [0.9,10] passes.

claims.statement: 單凭讀取比例不能宣佈模型理解某個概念；本節兩格只作數值演示、沒有固定語意。
claims.scope: Limited caution about sufficiency of weight interpretation; no universal assertion that attention can never be interpreted.

claims.statement: 一般nn.Linear權重可以為負，也無需加總為1；本節的比例另行採用非負總和1分配。

evidence.supports: Official Linear uses affine y=xA^T+b with learned Parameter, initialization allowing negatives and no sum-one normalization.
Ordinary Linear accepts[-2,4], sum2, and gives6 on input[1,2], confirming negative and unnormalized coefficients are permitted.
